description: This file contains functions and classes for marking, scooping, and compiling regions of a Torch FX graph for inductor optimization, including support for custom annotations and recursive processing.

classes.name: _RegionScooper
classes.description: Class responsible for scooping out inductor-marked regions in a Torch FX graph without compiling them.

classes.name: _RegionCompiler
classes.description: Class responsible for compiling scooped out regions in a Torch FX graph.

methods.name: _dummy_wrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to make Fx graph codegen happy by wrapping a function.

methods.name: _partition_by_supported_nodes
methods.description: Partitions a graph module based on supported nodes using a capability-based partitioner.

methods.name: _compile_submod
methods.description: Compiles a submodule with inductor based on custom annotations and replaces it in the graph.

methods.name: _needs_inductor_compile
methods.description: Checks if a node needs to be compiled with inductor based on its metadata.

methods.name: _create_inductor_marked_regions
methods.description: Creates regions marked for inductor compilation in a graph.

methods.name: _compile_inductor_marked_regions
methods.description: Compiles all inductor-marked regions in a graph.

methods.name: regional_inductor
methods.description: Main function that scoops out inductor-marked regions and compiles them, supporting custom annotations.
